rootPanels.noRoadHint: road — do not lay a road
rootPanels.guardValueHint: guardValue — override of the guard strength
rootPanels.listsHint: includeLists — lists from the database (for choice groups)
rootPanels.groupNameTitle: Group name — referenced by zones (renaming updates the references)
rootPanels.groupDeleteConfirmMc: You are about to delete group “{{name}}” ({{items}} items · {{zones}} zones). References to the group will be removed from zones of all variants. Are you sure?

rootPanels.mcNamesNote: Group names are arbitrary identifiers coined by template authors: zones reference them by exact string match. The mandatory_content_ prefix is an author convention; the game data (core_db) contains no such strings.
rootPanels.emptyGroups: No groups — create the first one.
rootPanels.limitListsHint: includeLists — total limit on the class from the lists
rootPanels.clNamesNote: Group names are arbitrary identifiers coined by template authors: zones reference them by exact string match. The content_limits_ prefix is an author convention; the game data (core_db) contains no such strings.

win_condition_1.label: Classic
win_condition_1.desc: Defeat all enemy heroes and capture every enemy city to win.

win_condition_2.label: Capital Capture
win_condition_2.desc: Capture the opponent’s starting city to win.

win_condition_3.label: Capital Hold
win_condition_3.desc: Capture the opponent’s starting city and hold it for a set number of in-game days to win.

win_condition_4.label: Final Battle
win_condition_4.desc: Face the opponent’s hero in a final battle. The winner claims victory in the game.

win_condition_5.label: City Hold
win_condition_5.desc: Capture the marked neutral city and hold it for a set number of in-game days to win.

win_condition_6.label: Tournament
win_condition_6.desc: Face the opponent’s hero in a series of battles. The winner of the set claims victory in the game.

SingleHero.label: Single Hero
SingleHero.desc: If your hero dies, you lose the game.

bonusHints.add_bonus_hero_spell: Give the hero a spell; parameters = [spell sid], e.g. neutral_magic_town_portal (“Town Portal”)
bonusHints.add_bonus_hero_stat: Modify hero parameters; in practice, in stock templates: [movementBonus, 0] (movement points) or [magicCostSidSet, spell_sid, −N, 0] (reduce the casting cost; −999 = free)
bonusHints.add_bonus_hero_item: Give the hero an artifact; parameters = [artifact sid], e.g. swamp_boots_artifact (“Swamp Boots”)
bonusHints.add_bonus_hero_unit_multipler: Hypothesis: hero unit multiplier (parameters = [2] in stock templates; what exactly it doubles is not confirmed)

root.descHint: description — localization sid (templates_description_*) or your own text
root.sizeXHint: sizeX — 80–240, a multiple of 16, always square
root.sizeZHint: sizeZ — 80–240, a multiple of 16, always square
root.heroCountIncrementHint: heroCountIncrement — increment of the hero limit (per week/city?); the in-game template description calls it “Heroes per City” (hypothesis)
root.heroHireBanHint: heroHireBan — forbids hiring new heroes; enabled in all 23 stock templates of the Single Hero mode, disabled in the other 37
root.encounterHolesHint: encounterHoles — master switch of the “holes” mechanic (a generation glitch: a pickup slot or tile goes missing in an encounter); enabled only in Anarchy among stock templates; the shares live in zones (encounterHolesSettings)
root.receiverFilterHint: receiverFilter — who receives the bonus (the starting hero / all heroes)
root.parametersHint: 1–4 bonus arguments. Examples from stock templates: [movementBonus, 0]; [magicCostSidSet, neutral_magic_town_portal, -999, 0] (free cast); [gold, 10000]; [swamp_boots_artifact] (“Swamp Boots”)
root.paramSpellHint: parameters = [spell sid]. In stock templates — adventure spells: “Town Portal”, “Shadowflight”, “Dimension Door”, “Primordial Chaos”
root.paramStatKindHint: First element of parameters: movementBonus — movement points; magicCostSidSet — spell casting cost
root.paramMoveBonusHint: Always 0 in stock templates; the exact meaning of the value is not confirmed (hypothesis: a bonus to movement points)
root.paramMagicCostHint: A negative number: −999 — free cast, −10/−15 — reduce the cost by N. The trailing 0 in parameters is saved automatically
root.paramMultiplierHint: 2 in stock templates; hypothesis: hero unit multiplier
root.paramRawHint: parameters does not match the stock form of this bonus — edit as a raw list
root.wcClassicHint: classic — defeat all enemy heroes and capture every enemy city
root.wcDesertionHint: desertion — defeat when falling behind by desertionValue by desertionDay
root.desertionDayHint: desertionDay — the day by which the gap is checked (= 3 in stock templates)
root.desertionValueHint: desertionValue — the size of the gap that leads to defeat (= 3000 in stock templates)
root.heroLightingHint: heroLighting — hypothesis: “lighting up” the opponent’s hero (fog reveal); always true in stock templates
root.heroLightingDayHint: heroLightingDay — start day (= 1 in stock templates)
root.wcLostStartCityHint: lostStartCity — defeat upon losing the starting city
root.lostStartCityDayHint: lostStartCityDay — after how many days losing the city becomes a defeat (1–3)
root.wcLostStartHeroHint: lostStartHero — defeat upon losing the starting hero
root.wcCityHoldHint: cityHold — capture the marked neutral city and hold it for the given number of days
root.holdCityWinConHint: holdCityWinCon — hypothesis: an alternative version of cityHold (paired with mainObjects.holdCityWinCon)
root.wcGladiatorArenaHint: gladiatorArena — a battle arena for heroes: a few days after it is visited, a battle occurs whose winner wins the whole game (official object description)
root.gladiatorRegWorkHint: gladiatorArenaRegistrationStartWork — hypothesis: arena registration when approaching the “worker”
root.gladiatorRegFightHint: gladiatorArenaRegistrationStartFight — registration starts with the fight
root.gladiatorDaysDelayHint: gladiatorArenaDaysDelayStart — the day the arena starts (21–30 in stock templates)
root.gladiatorCountDayHint: gladiatorArenaCountDay — frequency of battles, in days (1–8)
root.wcTournamentHint: tournament — face the opponent’s hero in a series of battles; the winner of several fights wins the match
root.tournamentSaveArmyHint: tournamentSaveArmy — keep the army between rounds; true in all 9 stock tournament templates
root.tournamentDaysHint: tournamentDays — 3–5 values; displayed in-game as “Battle Dates”
root.championSelectHint: championSelectRule — the champion is the starting hero (the only value is StartHero)
root.overridesHint: Override of guardValue for an object sid+variant (overrides the “price/guards” from the database).
root.bansHint: Sid bans apply globally to the whole map.
root.bansMagicsHint: magics — sids of map adventure spells. In stock templates: neutral_magic_light_gate “Gate of Light”, neutral_magic_dimension_door “Dimension Door”, neutral_magic_shadow_form “Shadowflight”, neutral_magic_pocket_dimension “Pocket Dimension”, neutral_magic_town_portal “Town Portal” and others.
root.bansItemsHint: items — artifact sids. In stock templates: voodoosh_doll_artifact “Voodoo Doll”, flag_of_truce_artifact “Flag of Truce”, shackles_of_war_artifact “Shackles of War”, swamp_boots_artifact “Swamp Boots”, magic_scroll_artifact_<spell> “Magic Scroll: …” and others.
root.bansSkillsHint: skills — hero skill sids. In stock templates: skill_siege “Siegecraft”, skill_logistic “Logistics”.
root.bansHeroesHint: heroes — sids of specific heroes of the form <faction>_hero_<number>. In stock templates: human_hero_8 “Lord Edgar”, demon_hero_3 “Nor”, unfrozen_hero_14 “Tölketh” and others.
root.layoutsHint: Zone layout parameters; zones reference the name (zone.layout). In stock templates every layout always has obstaclesFill, obstaclesFillVoid, lakesFill, elevationClusterScale, roadClusterArea, guardedEncounterResourceFractions and ambientPickupDistribution set; minLakeArea and elevationModes are optional.
root.layoutNameHint: name — an arbitrary key name of the layout, created by the template author in this section (by the game developers in stock templates); the game does not localize it. Zones reference the layout by this name (zone.layout)
root.obstaclesFillHint: obstaclesFill — share of the area taken by obstacles (0–1; 0.18–0.8 in stock templates)
root.obstaclesVoidHint: obstaclesFillVoid — hypothesis: obstacle density on the unused remnants of the zone (0.18–0.85)
root.lakesFillHint: lakesFill — share of the area taken by lakes (0.1–0.45)
root.minLakeAreaHint: minLakeArea — in tiles (5–16); smaller lakes are not drawn. The field is optional: present in 105 of 174 layouts in stock templates
root.roadClusterAreaHint: roadClusterArea — in tiles (50–160); the territory along roads is structured into clusters
root.modeMinElevHint: minElevatedFraction — lower bound of the elevated terrain share (0 = flat zone; 0.2–0.4 ≈ hills)
root.gerFractionsHint: guardedEncounterResourceFractions.fractions — the share of the zone’s guarded encounters filled from the resource pool. Always a single number 0.5–1 in stock templates (exact semantics unclear)
root.elevationTitleHint: elevationModes[] — weighted selection of a terrain mode: 1–3 modes per layout; weight 0 disables a mode. Fraction pairs: 0–0 = flat zone, 0.2–0.4 ≈ hills, 0.6–0.8 ≈ mountains
root.countBoundsHint: guardedEncounterResourceFractions.countBounds — bounds on the number of encounters the fractions apply to. Always an empty array in stock templates: the fraction applies to all guarded encounters of the zone
root.ambientTitleHint: ambientPickupDistribution — placement of ambient pickups (small resources along roads). Present in all layouts in stock templates
root.ambientRepulsionHint: repulsion — pickups push each other apart (always 1 in stock templates)
root.ambientNoiseHint: noise — random scatter of the points (0.3–0.4 in stock templates)
root.ambientRoadHint: roadAttraction — attraction to roads; can be negative (−0.3…0.5 in stock templates)
root.ambientObstacleHint: obstacleAttraction — attraction to obstacles (0–0.05 in stock templates)
root.groupSizeWeightsHint: groupSizeWeights — weights of pickup groups by size: 3 numbers for groups of 1/2/3 items (e.g. [20, 2, 1] in stock templates — almost always singles)
root.jsonHint: All global template information in one block: name, gameMode, sizes, gameRules, zoneLayouts, mandatory content, etc. + variants without zones/connections (those are edited on the canvas). The number and order of variants cannot be changed.
